meta.name: datamol
meta.description: Pythonic wrapper around RDKit with simplified interface and sensible defaults. Preferred for standard drug discovery including SMILES parsing, standardization, descriptors, fingerprints, clustering, 3D conformers, parallel processing. Returns native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects. For advanced control or custom parameters, use rdkit directly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理化学分子数据，计算描述符和指纹。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在药物发现中处理分子结构并计算属性。
copy.tagline_en: Process chemical molecular data, compute descriptors and fingerprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle molecular structures and compute properties in drug discovery.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能调用 datamol 化学工具库处理分子:读懂分子结构代码、整理分子、计算性质、做相似性比较、生成三维构象等,并产出原生 rdkit 分子对象。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理化学分子、做药物发现类计算时触发,例如解析或标准化 SMILES、计算描述符或指纹、聚类或生成 3D 构象等。

say.text: 帮我把这个 SMILES 转成标准化分子:CC(=O)O
say.note: 会返回标准化后的 rdkit 分子对象。

say.text: 算这 100 个分子的描述符和指纹,按 Lipinski 规则过滤。
say.note: 会输出描述符表格和过滤后的分子列表。

say.text: 对这些分子做 Butina 聚类,再挑 50 个多样性的代表。
say.note: 会返回聚类结果和挑出的代表分子。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use datamol to process chemical molecules: read structure codes, standardize molecules, compute properties, compare similarity, and generate 3D conformers, returning native rdkit.Chem.Mol objects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to process chemical molecules or do drug-discovery tasks, e.g., parse or convert SMILES, compute descriptors, or generate 3D conformers.

say_en.text: Standardize this SMILES and return the molecule: CC(=O)O
Get descriptors and fingerprints for these 100 molecules; filter with Lipinski.
say_en.note: Outputs a descriptor table and the filtered molecules.

say_en.text: Cluster these molecules with Butina and pick 50 diverse representatives.
say_en.note: Returns clusters and the picked diverse subset.
